title: Fox interviewed all three Rendlesham witnesses
summary: James Fox tells of Fox interviewed all three Rendlesham witnesses, about 1980 at RAF Woodbridge, Suffolk, England, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: only I'm the only person to have interviewed cabansag burough and penison

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFOs, says he is the only person to have interviewed all three main witnesses of the Rendlesham Forest incident. That is a reported 1980 encounter with a strange craft in woods beside RAF Woodbridge, a British air base used by the US military in Suffolk, England. He names the three as Cabansag, John Burroughs and Jim Penniston, which would make his account the fullest record of what they say they saw.
